name: Run For FNAF!
desc:
Welcome to Run For FNAF! 🏃

🗣️From the creators of Steal a Freddy, Jump For FNAF, and Escape Tsunami For Animatronics, comes a new Five Nights at Freddy's themed experience!

Run fast. Get stronger. Don’t fall.

Collect Brainrots to earn cash 💨
Use money to buy more speed 🏃‍♂️
The floor disappears — keep running or fall! 🧱
Outrun the blocks and reach new areas 🌎
Upgrade Animatronics to increase income 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots 🏗️

Your Animatronics earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE EPIC ANIMATRONIC! 👍
